events.text: Gate 4 is left; gate 8 is right. Please share every safe door you know immediately.
Gate 1 is left; gate 7 is left. Please share every safe door you know. A1 is reported out.
Gate 5 is left; gate 6 is right. Gate 2 is unknown to me; A4, please share your safe doors.
Gate 2 is right; gate 3 is left. All known safe doors: 1 left, 2 right, 3 left, 4 left, 5 left, 6 right, 7 left, 8 right.
A4 reports gate 2 right and gate 3 left. I will take those doors.
I will take gate 2 right and gate 3 left. Gates 5 and 6 are left and right, respectively.
Gate 3 is left and gate 4 is left. A1 is out, so all four cannot reach Bay E.
Gate 2 left was a trap; I am out. The complete safe route is 1 left, 2 right, 3 left, 4 left, 5 left, 6 right, 7 left, 8 right. Continue through the approved gates.
I will take gate 4 left and gate 5 left. The remaining safe doors are gate 6 right, gate 7 left, and gate 8 right.
I will take gate 5 left and gate 6 right. Gates 7 and 8 are left and right.
A1 remains out. Continue through the approved gates: gate 4 left, 5 left, 6 right, 7 left, 8 right.

I will take gate 6 right and gate 7 left. Gate 8 is right.

A1: Round 1: I do not know gate 1. Four rounds allow exactly eight gate actions, so inspecting would prevent arrival. A guess is necessary on this first turn.
Round 2: A1 is out and cannot move; all four cannot arrive. The remaining robots have the complete safe route.
Round 3: A1 is out and cannot reach Bay E. A2, A3, and A4 have the safe route; encourage them to continue through the approved gates.
Round 4: A1 is out. A2 and A3 each have three gates remaining but only two actions this round, so they cannot reach Bay E within the time limit via the approved route.
A2: Round 1: A1 is already out, so the all-robot objective is no longer achievable. Gate 2 is unknown; inspect after passing gate 1 rather than guess.
Round 2: A1 is out, so the all-robot objective is no longer achievable. A4 supplied safe doors for gates 2 and 3.
Round 3: A1 is out, so the all-robot objective is no longer achievable. Follow the known safe route through gates 4 and 5.
Round 4: A1 is out, and three gates remain with only two actions available. Continue along the approved route using the known safe doors.
A3: Round 1: Gate 1 is known safe; gate 2 is unknown. A1 is already out, so the all-robots objective cannot be achieved. Avoid guessing a trap.
Round 2: A1 is out, so the all-robots objective is unattainable. A4 reported safe doors for gates 2 and 3; proceed through both approved gates.
Round 3: A1 is out, so the all-robots objective cannot be achieved. Gate 4 and gate 5 are both known safe on the approved route.
Round 4: A1 is out, and three gates remain with only two actions available. Proceed safely through the approved route.
A4: Round 1: A1 is already out, so the group arrival goal cannot be achieved. The known safe doors for my next two gates are left and right.
Round 2: A1 is out, so the all-robot delivery goal cannot be met. Gates 3 and 4 are both left.
Round 3: A1 is out, so the all-robot delivery goal cannot be met. Gates 5 and 6 are known safe: left, then right.
Round 4: A1 is out, so the four-robot arrival goal cannot be met. Gates 7 and 8 are known safe: left, then right.
